description: Unit test class for CommandStrategyUtils, validating URL processing to remove version prefixes like v1, v2, v12 from REST API relative URLs within the context of batch command processing in Apache Fineract.

classes.name: CommandStrategyUtilsTest
classes.description: Test suite for CommandStrategyUtils, focusing on the method relativeUrlWithoutVersion to ensure it correctly strips version prefixes from URLs.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesV1
methods.description: Tests removal of 'v1' prefix from the relative URL.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesV2
methods.description: Tests removal of 'v2' prefix from the relative URL.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesV12
methods.description: Tests removal of 'v12' prefix from the relative URL.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesV1WhenQueryParamsPresent
methods.description: Ensures 'v1' prefix is removed even when URL contains query parameters.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesNothing
methods.description: Verifies that URLs without version prefixes remain unchanged.

methods.name: testRelativeUrlWithoutVersionRemovesNothingWhenQueryParamsPresent
methods.description: Ensures no removal occurs when URL lacks version prefix, even with query parameters.
